Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_count1 number;
 temp_batch_ID VARCHAR2(14);
 v_check_digit VARCHAR2(2);
 v_count number;
Begin 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 --RP Task# 166 05022028
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID), 0) NOT IN (7,13) and NVL(:ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_ID,'M') = 'M'
 then
 show_error('1190');
 --message('Unit Length mut be 7 or 13 Characters.');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 --Make sure user enter only Alpha Numeric only. Check A -> 65, Z -> 90, 0 -> 48, 9 -> 57
 If NVL(:ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_ID,'M') = 'M' then
 FOR i in 1..length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID) LOOP 
 if ASCII(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID, i, 1)) BETWEEN 65 and 90 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID, i, 1)) BETWEEN 48 and 57
 then
 null; 
 else
 show_error('5193');
 --message('Unit mut be Alpha Numeric Characters only.');
 EXIT;
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 END LOOP;
 
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID), 0) >= 13 then
 --Check digit should be populated for ISBT/for unit less than 13 digits -- 05082018
 validate_unit_chkdigit ( :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID ,v_check_digit ) ;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := v_check_digit;
 end if;
 
 End if;
 --Task# 166
 
 -- Validate the unit_id
 
 
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 Exception
 when OTHERS
 then

End;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FOR_ACCESS_1
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_for_access_1 IS
 ucnt NUMBER := 0;
 dcnt NUMBER := 0;
 v_flg VARCHAR2(1) := 'N';
 lv_user_id VARCHAR2(10);
 v_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.uaccess := '';

 IF v_flg = 'N' THEN 
 
 lv_user_id := lt_user_session.get_userid;
 
 -- IM 124
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 --
 
 
 SELECT count(*) INTO ucnt
 FROM valid_lab_user_access
 WHERE user_id = lv_user_id
 AND access_class = 'UNOTE'
 AND v_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_sysdate+1); -- IM 124
 
 IF ucnt = 0 THEN
 globalvar.g_access := 'N'; -- Used to disable NOTE field.
 END IF; 
 
 SELECT count(*) INTO dcnt
 FROM valid_lab_user_access
 WHERE user_id = lv_user_id
 AND access_class = 'DNOTE'
 AND v_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_sysdate+1); -- IM 124
 
 IF ucnt > 0 THEN
 :ctrl_blk_2.warn := NULL;
 v_flg := 'Y';
 ELSE 
 v_flg := 'Y';
 item_change('note_books.note','D');

ProgramUnit.Name: ITEM_CHANGE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE item_change (p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2) IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 if p_mode = 'E' then
 IF get_item_property(it_id, ENABLED) = 'FALSE' THEN
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 set_item_property(it_id,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 if get_item_property(it_id,ITEM_TYPE) != 'BUTTON' then
 set_item_property(it_id,UPDATEABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 end if ;
 END IF;
 elsif p_mode = 'D' then
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
END;

PROCEDURE populate_note_id IS
 prev_seq number:=0; 
Begin
 
 go_block('note_books');
 select NOTEBOOK_SEQ.nextval into :ctrl_blk_2.note_id from dual;
 :note_books.note_seq := 1; 
 item_change('note_books.note', 'E');
 go_item('note_books.note');

Exception 
 when others then
 message(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 100));PAUSE; --('Note ID is missing');
End;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 nNextSeq number:=0;
 note_seq number:=0;
 pl_note_id NUMBER;
Begin
 
 
 go_block('ctrl_units');
 first_record;
 
LOOP
 
 begin
 select note_id into pl_note_id from UNITS where unit_id=:ctrl_units.unit_id and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and rownum=1;
 exception when no_data_found then 
 null;
 when others then 
 null;
 end;
 
 --message('Unit='||:ctrl_units.unit_id||' Note ID='||pl_note_id);pause;
 
 
 IF pl_note_id is null then 
 
 :ctrl_blk_2.note_id:=NOTEBOOK_SEQ.nextval;
 
 update units set note_id=:ctrl_blk_2.note_id where unit_id=:ctrl_units.unit_id and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 
 go_block('note_books');
 first_record;
 
 note_seq:=0;
 Loop
 note_seq:=note_seq+1;
 If :note_books.note is not null then
 
 --message('Unit='||:ctrl_units.unit_id||' Next seq='|| to_char(note_seq) ||' current Note ID='||pl_note_id||' New note='||:ctrl_blk_2.note_id);pause;
 
 begin
 insert into note_books (NOTE_ID,
 NOTE,
 AUDIT_KEY,
 NOTE_SEQ,
 NOTES_TABLE,
 CHAPTER_ID,
 PROGRAM_ID,
 INSERT_USER,
 INSERT_DATE,
 NOTES_TYPE)
 VALUES (:ctrl_blk_2.note_id,
 :note_books.note,
 audit_seq_lab.nextval,
 note_seq,
 'UNITS',
 :global.chapter_id,
 :banner.prog_name,
 :banner.user_id,
 sysdate,
 null);
 exception when others then 
 message('error-1 '||sqlerrm);pause;
 end;
 
 End If;
 
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 Else
 next_record;
 End if; 
 
 End loop; 
 
 ELSE
 --- get the maximum seq number for the note ID
 
 select max(note_seq) into nNextSeq from note_books where note_id=pl_note_id;
 
 --message('next sequence='|| to_char(nNextSeq));pause;
 
 go_block('note_books');
 first_record;
 
 note_seq:=nvl(nNextSeq,0);
 Loop
 
 If :note_books.note is not null then 
 
 note_seq:=note_seq+1;
 
 --message('next sequence='|| to_char(note_seq));pause;
 begin
 insert into note_books (NOTE_ID,
 NOTE,
 AUDIT_KEY,
 NOTE_SEQ,
 NOTES_TABLE,
 CHAPTER_ID,
 PROGRAM_ID,
 INSERT_USER,
 INSERT_DATE,
 NOTES_TYPE)
 VALUES (pl_note_id,
 :note_books.note,
 audit_seq_lab.nextval,
 note_seq,
 'UNITS',
 :global.chapter_id,
 :banner.prog_name,
 :banner.user_id,
 sysdate,
 null);
 exception
 when others then 
 message('error-1 '||sqlerrm);pause;
 end;
 
 
 End If;
 
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 Else
 next_record;
 End if; 
 
 End loop; 
 
 END IF;
 
 go_block('ctrl_units');
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;

END LOOP;

:system.message_level:= 10 ;
 commit_form ;
 show_error('9163') ;
:system.message_level:= 0 ;


Exception 
 when others then 
 message('Error-3 '||sqlerrm);pause;
End;
